description:
LANDED b32d645ac (2026-09-01; ROUND OF THREE: first build BLOCKED by
its refuter with a 5-line reproducer, fix round validated, re-refute
FIX-THEN-MERGE with a third-instance hole closed in-round; gate lib
1546/0/5, cli 24/0, matrix 443/0/9).

THE DEFECT: dispatch arm order was fixpoint-arrival order, and
fz-kdt.125's restored arm made the predicate lens FIFO/LIFO
canon-divergent (two distinguishable nested arms swapping).

THREE ORDERING RULES DIED BEFORE THE SOUND ONE (all pinned red):
(1) surface-narrowest-first (ticket candidate): the narrower TYPE can
carry the WIDER test -- JIT abort. (2) test-narrowest-first (first
build): the narrower TEST's body can be blind to what arrives --
5-line reproducer (Enum.all?([:ok,:ok]) + empty? + all?([1,2])), base
green everywhere, build aborted JIT+AOT both schedules; BLOCKED.
(3) covers-with-difference-as-separation (fix round): 'the tests
differ' is NOT separation on an ERASING axis -- arities {2} and {2,3}
both admit a 2-tuple (refuter's unit refutation; unconstructible from
source today but a false doc claim) -- closed in-round.

THE LANDED RULE: arms seat by question group (members keep arrival --
the fz-kdt.107 carve-out by construction); groups start in ARRIVAL
order; a backward-insertion pass moves x ahead of y only when
covers(x,y) AND (not covers(y,x) OR x's test strictly inside y's) --
obligation first, precision second -- where covers demands, at every
position where the tests could both admit a value on an erasing axis
(overlaps_on_an_erasing_axis: list elements, tuple payloads,
struct/map/binary/resource contents; exact axes ints/floats/atoms/
callables separate by difference), that x's surface contains y's.
covers is NON-TRANSITIVE by nature, hence insertion-stopping-at-first-
refusal, not a comparator; every inversion is individually
covers-checked (debug_assert every_inversion_covers + refuter's
production-path probe: 0 unchecked inversions over 582 fixtures) --
the seat's blind escapes are a SUBSET of arrival's by construction.

RESULTS (all refuter-re-measured): predicate lens FIFO==LIFO restored,
census 4->3, all four lenses byte-identical, survivors' deltas
byte-identical to base's; escape census 19==base's 19 entry-for-entry
(blocked build had 22), ratcheted; canon 3 movers (:timeout/int-
before-any precision reseats in receive-adjacent Kernel.+/2 dispatch
-- receive clause plans PROVEN untouched, three ways, incl. driving
the after-timeout path); 582-sweep interp+JIT 0 movers, AOT identical
on movers; inventory 0 delta; determinism + reversal-stress green.
Reproducer landed as dispatch_seat_element_blind (3 doors, Elixir
oracle). Gates rewritten: the defect-asserting contained-first gate
DELETED for the covering-arm property gate (proven>0 guard); census
ratchet at 19 (retired by fz-kdt.119/107); both unit gates run both
arrival orders.

RESIDUE (recorded, owned): the neither-covers population stays
arrival-decided = fz-kdt.131 (enum_map_family's schedule delta alone
holds 150 arm lines; the reversal stress does NOT exercise
cross-group order -- fz-kdt.131 needs a cross-group permutation
stress); the 19 escapes are all list-shape blindness = fz-kdt.107
step 3. THE INSTRUMENT LESSON (third occurrence): whole-corpus stdout
sweeps pass while dispatch defects ship; the reproducer-fixture +
both-arrival-order unit gates are the only instruments that catch
this class.
title: A seat is arrival order corrected only where an arm covers what its test cannot see
